description: Viser firmaet tilkoblingen gjelder (ID og navn), rollen din, den registrerte assistenten og verktøyene du har tilgang til.
name: revly_kontekst

outputSchema.description: Connection context: firm, role, assistant and the allowed read tools.

allowed_tools.description: Read tools this connection may call.

display_name.description: Assistant display name as registered for this connection.

host.description: Host key for the assistant (for example claude, chatgpt, grok or generic).

id.description: Registered client ID for this connection.

firma_id.description: ID of the firm this connection is for, as text.

firma_navn.description: Name of the firm this connection is for.

firma_rolle.description: Your role in the firm, for example partner.

operation_id.description: Revly operation ID for this read, recorded in the access log.

status.description: available when the connection is valid.

title: Tilkoblingskontekst fra Revly
